name: @samebase/identity-broker-effect
description: The identity broker in Effect, one code base for every host. Cloudflare is the first host.

scripts.lint: pnpm --dir ../.. exec vp lint --tsconfig packages/identity-broker-effect/tsconfig.node.json --report-unused-disable-directives packages/identity-broker-effect/src packages/identity-broker-effect/alchemy.run.ts packages/identity-broker-effect/test
scripts.test: pnpm --dir ../.. exec vp test run --project identity-broker-effect --project identity-broker-effect-machine
scripts.test:quick: pnpm --dir ../.. exec vp test run --project identity-broker-effect
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test:quick
